Bridge over Sone opens for light traffic

The new bridge over the Sone river was opened for light motor vehicles on Sunday, nearly a year behind schedule.

Officials said heavy vehicles would be allowed after load testing scheduled next month, with trial runs already completed on two spans.

The 3.2-km bridge is expected to ease congestion on the old bridge, where traffic jams stretched for hours during the harvest season.

Commuters welcomed the opening but questioned the delay, pointing to three missed deadlines announced earlier.
